summary: No trust boundary is touched, which matches spec section 8. The change is limited to the in-memory invariant checker (src/engine/invariants.ts), the playtest summary and runner typing (src/playtest/runner.ts), CLI report text (src/playtest/cli.ts) and test support. The new K4 deal-order check runs only after isCard validation and the exactly-2-hole-cards check. Out-of-range deck lookups degrade to 'no card' rather than throwing. The P3 change replaces an unchecked PlayerState cast with an undefined guard, which closes a possible throw. historyMessage interpolates only engine-produced street strings into a terminal report, with no HTML, shell or filesystem sink. No new dependencies, secrets, randomness, file I/O or unbounded input. The faulty-engine MAX_ACTIONS_PER_HAND bound is test-only and reduces resource exhaustion. No findings.
